concepts.def: Card that spends from your own account
Card that borrows from the bank
Managing money through an app or site

walkthroughs.body_html:
Debit cards spend money you already have.

Credit cards spend the bank's money — you pay back later.

Spend over the credit limit and you'll pay big interest. 💳

Contactless lets you tap and pay up to £100 in the UK.

Apps like Apple Pay turn your phone into a card.

Online banking lets you check, save and send money anywhere.

Digital money is fast — but easy to steal. Fraud is huge.

Safe habits:

  • Never share your PIN or password.
  • Watch for fake texts ('your account is locked!').
  • Check statements often.

If in doubt, don't click. 🚫
